options.reason: A direct annual bar chart makes year-to-year differences and individual totals easy to compare.

options.grouping: Crash year and recorded borough (including not recorded)
options.reason: The borough stacks show each annual total while revealing how recorded locations contribute to it.
options.answer: Summing the borough segments gives these annual totals: 2013: 176; 2014: 133; 2015: 133; 2016: 149; 2017: 127; 2018: 123; 2019: 131; 2020: 101; 2021: 132; 2022: 135; 2023: 107; 2024: 124; 2025: 119; the chart also shows the recorded-borough composition, with missing boroughs retained as Not recorded.

options.denominator: None; monthly counts summed to annual totals
options.reason: Monthly shading preserves the requested annual totals while showing how pedestrian deaths vary within each year.
options.answer: Summing the monthly cells gives these annual totals: 2013: 176; 2014: 133; 2015: 133; 2016: 149; 2017: 127; 2018: 123; 2019: 131; 2020: 101; 2021: 132; 2022: 135; 2023: 107; 2024: 124; 2025: 119; the heatmap also displays their month-by-month distribution.
